chapter: Studio work, Herbie Mann and recording
title: First studio date, with Donald Byrd's big band
summary: His first recording was Byrd's 'I'm Trying to Get Home' with Clark Terry and Snooky Young.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: When did you first record? Go into a recording studio?

In a recording studio? I think in 1964, I did a recording with Donald Byrd on one of those big albums. I was in the trumpet section with Clark Terry, Stanley Turrentine was in the band. Snooky Young was in the band. It was a great recording. I think it was called “I’m Trying To Get Home.” That was the album with voices, which is the second album he made with voices in a big band. I copied a lot of that music. I used to copy music by hand.
